info.title: Scenario API
info.description: Provides APIs to access and manage Scenarios and their Test Cases within an AccelQ project.

accelqLoginUrl.description: The AccelQ login URL for API access.

ApiKey.description: API Key found under Auth Properties in ACCELQ User Profile.

post.description:
Fetches comprehensive information about test Scenarios within your project. This endpoint supports:

- **Pagination**: Control response size with configurable page numbers and sizes (max 25 items per page)
- **Flexible Filtering**: Filter by specific Scenario IDs or requirement traceability keys
- **Optional Detailed Information**: Selectively include additional details such as custom fields, step details, requirement traceability, scenario traceability, last run details and defects in the response
- **User-Specific Version View**: Results reflect the requesting user's current version of the entities.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Use this to navigate through large result sets efficiently.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Number of Scenarios to return per page.

**Constraints**:
- Minimum: 1
- Maximum: 25
- Default: 20

filter.description:
**Filtering Criteria** for scenario selection. When multiple criteria are provided, they are combined using logical AND.

**Empty Filter Behavior**: Returns all accessible scenarios in the project.

scenarioIds.description: Optional. Specifies the list of Scenario IDs to filter the results. If not provided, information for all available scenarios will be retrieved.

requirementKeys.description: Optional. List of requirement traceability keys used to filter scenarios. Returns all scenarios linked to any of the specified requirement keys.

steps.description: Flag to include the auto Scenario step details in the response. This will be ignored for manual Scenarios.

requirementTraceability.description: Flag to include the Scenario requirement traceability details in the response.

customFields.description: Flag to include Scenario custom fields. Defaults to false, if not specified.

scenarioTraceability.description: Flag to include Scenario traceability linkage with other scenarios in the response. Defaults to false, if not specified.

lastRunInfo.description: Flag to include the last run details of the Scenario in the response. Defaults to false, if not specified.

defects.description: Flag to include the defects associated with the Scenario in the response. Defaults to false, if not specified.

200.description: **Successful retrieval** of Scenario details with comprehensive information about filtered Scenarios.

patch.summary: Bulk update Scenario Requirement Traceability, Status and Custom Fields
patch.description:
Updates the requirement traceability, status, and custom fields of one or more Scenarios.

#### Custom fields

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entries`     | Custom fields to set, as pairs of name and value. Refer to the Custom field rules section below for the format of each value. |
| `updateType`     | Update type for a multi-select custom field. `APPEND` keeps the existing options and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing options with the new ones. |

`updateType` applies to custom fields of the Multi-select type only. It is required when a request updates a Multi-select custom field. It is not allowed when none of the custom fields in the request are of the Multi-select type.

#### Custom field rules

* Custom field names are case-insensitive.
* A custom field that does not exist in the project causes the request to fail with an error.
* A custom field with an empty value is ignored and keeps its current value.

| Field type | Value format |
| --- | --- |
| Text, Text area | Plain text of up to 4096 characters. |
| Date | Date in `MM/dd/yyyy` format, for example `12/31/2026`. |
| Boolean | `True` or `False`. The values `1` and `0` are also accepted. |
| User list | Email address of a user that exists in the project. |
| Single select | An option that exists for the field. |
| Multi-select | Option names separated by commas, for example `chrome,firefox`. To include a comma in an option name, write it as `\\,`. For example, `chrome\\,browser` selects the single option `chrome,browser`. |

requirementTraceability.description: Contains details for updating requirement traceability of Scenario entities.

patch.summary: Bulk update Test Case Tags and Custom Fields
patch.description:
Updates the tags and custom fields of one or more Test Cases in a Scenario.

#### Request fields

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `testCaseIds`     | IDs of the Test Cases to update. |
| `tags`     | Tags to apply to each Test Case. Refer to the Tags section below. |
| `customFields`     | Custom fields to set on each Test Case. Refer to the Custom fields section below. |

`testCaseIds` is required. At least one of `tags` or `customFields` is also required. Requests that do not meet these conditions fail with an error.

#### Tags

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entries`     | Tags to apply to each Test Case. Each tag can have up to 255 characters. |
| `updateType`     | Determines how the specified tags are applied. `APPEND` keeps the existing tags and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing tags with the new ones. |

Both `entries` and `updateType` are required for `tags`. Requests that omit either one fail with an error.

#### Custom fields

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entries`     | Custom fields to set, as pairs of name and value. Refer to the Custom field rules section below for the format of each value. |
| `updateType`     | Update type for a multi-select custom field. `APPEND` keeps the existing options and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing options with the new ones. |

`updateType` applies to custom fields of the Multi-select type only. It is required when a request updates a Multi-select custom field. It is not allowed when none of the custom fields in the request are of the Multi-select type.

#### Custom field rules

* Custom field names are case-insensitive.
* A custom field that does not exist in the project causes the request to fail with an error.
* A custom field with an empty value is ignored and keeps its current value.

| Field type | Value format |
| --- | --- |
| Text, Text area | Plain text of up to 4096 characters. |
| Date | Date in `MM/dd/yyyy` format, for example `12/31/2026`. |
| Boolean | `True` or `False`. The values `1` and `0` are also accepted. |
| User list | Email address of a user that exists in the project. |
| Single select | An option that exists for the field. |
| Multi-select | Option names separated by commas, for example `chrome,firefox`. To include a comma in an option name, write it as `\\,`. For example, `chrome\\,browser` selects the single option `chrome,browser`. |
